tools.name: search-delta-news-hub
tools.description: Search Delta News Hub for published articles, press releases, fact sheets, leader biographies, images and videos. Returns titles, absolute URLs, content types, publication dates and short summaries, ranked by relevance. Use this instead of navigating to the search page; fetch a returned URL to read the full item.

keywords.description: Search terms, as a human would type them into the site search box. Plain keywords work best; this is a full-text search over article titles, summaries and body copy, not a natural-language question.

page.description: Zero-based page of results, for paging through more than `limit` matches.
